source.title_on_document: How do we measure creativity? A systematic review and taxonomy of evaluative methods in human-AI co-creativity

supplement.holds: The abstract does not mention supplementary material; the full text was not read.

paper_design_summary: A systematic review of the metrics and evaluation methods that human-AI co-creativity studies use to measure creativity. The authors analyze how creativity is conceptualized and measured and organize the evaluation practices into a taxonomy. The abstract reports no pooled effect of AI on creativity.
